paperDefaults.pageDescTemplate: Free GATE practice paper set {number} with detailed solutions.

questions.text: A person walks at 5 km/h and runs at 8 km/h. If total time for 13 km is 2 hours, how much did he walk?
questions.solution: Let walk time = t hr, run time = 2-t. 5t + 8(2-t) = 13 -> t = 1 hr. Walk distance = 5 km.

questions.text: The number of diagonals in a pentagon is:
questions.solution: n(n-3)/2 = 5(2)/2 = 5 diagonals.

questions.text: Select the synonym of "Ephemeral":
questions.solution: Ephemeral = short-lived/transient. Opposite = permanent.

questions.text: If a:b = 2:3 and b:c = 4:5, then a:c is:
A die is rolled once. Probability of getting an even number is:
questions.solution: Even: 2,4,6 (3 outcomes). P = 3/6 = 1/2.

questions.text: If x + y = 10 and xy = 21, then x^2 + y^2 is:
The unit of moment of inertia is:
questions.solution: Moment of inertia (area) has units of m.

questions.text: A simply supported beam with UDL has maximum bending moment at:
questions.solution: Mmax = wL^2/8 at mid-span for simply supported beam with UDL.

questions.text: The factor of safety is defined as:
questions.solution: FoS = ultimate load / allowable load = ultimate stress / working stress.

questions.text: The Euler's buckling load for a column depends on:

options.label: C
options.text: Length, E, I, and end conditions

questions.solution: Pcr = pi^2EI/(Le)^2. Depends on E, I, effective length (end conditions).

questions.text: Concrete is strong in:
questions.solution: Concrete has high compressive strength but low tensile strength (reinforced with steel).

questions.text: The void ratio of a soil is defined as:
questions.solution: Void ratio e = Vv/Vs (volume of voids / volume of solids).

questions.text: The liquid limit of a soil is determined using:
questions.solution: Casagrande's liquid limit device (cup + grooving tool).

questions.text: The bearing capacity of soil is improved by:
questions.solution: Compaction increases soil density -> higher bearing capacity.

questions.text: The standard penetration test (SPT) N-value indicates:
questions.solution: SPT N-value correlates with relative density and strength of soil.

questions.text: Darcy's law governs the flow of water through:
questions.solution: v = ki (Darcy's law for flow through porous media like soil).

questions.text: The unit of hydraulic gradient is:
questions.solution: Hydraulic gradient i = h/L (head loss / length) - dimensionless.

questions.text: Bernoulli's equation is based on:
questions.solution: P/g + v^2/2g + z = constant (energy per unit weight).

questions.text: The Chezy's coefficient C in Manning's formula relates to:
The optimum depth of a canal is when:
questions.solution: Most economical section: max hydraulic radius -> min wetted perimeter.

questions.text: The pH of pure water is:
questions.solution: Pure water has pH 7 at 25 degrees C (neutral).

questions.text: The grade of concrete M20 means:
questions.solution: M20 = 20 MPa (20 N/mm^2) characteristic compressive strength at 28 days.

questions.text: Quick sand condition occurs when:

options.label: B
options.text: Upward seepage force equals submerged weight

questions.solution: Quicksand: upward hydraulic gradient  critical gradient (ic = Gs-1)/(1+e).

questions.text: The Manning's roughness coefficient n for concrete is about:
questions.solution: Manning's n for concrete: 0.012-0.015 (typically 0.013).

questions.text: Slab spanning in one direction only is called:
questions.solution: One-way slab: L/B  2, main reinforcement in shorter span direction.

questions.text: The perimeter of a square is 40 cm. Its area is:
The dry density of soil is maximum at:
questions.solution: Proctor test: maximum dry density at OMC (optimum moisture content).

questions.text: The effective span of a simply supported beam is:
questions.solution: For simply supported: Le = min(Lc + d, c/c distance of supports).

questions.text: The total hardness of water is due to:
questions.solution: Hardness: Ca^2 and Mg^2 ions (temporary: bicarbonates, permanent: sulfates/chlorides).

questions.text: The plasticity chart classifies soil based on:
questions.solution: Casagrande's plasticity chart: LL vs PI to classify fine-grained soils (CL, CH, ML, MH).

questions.text: The sum of ages of A and B is 45 years. 5 years from now, the ratio of their ages will be 4:5. Find the current age of A.
If LOGIC is coded as 15-15-7-9-3, then what is the code for MATH?
What is the time complexity of binary search on a sorted array of n elements?
questions.solution: Binary search divides the search space in half each iteration, giving O(log n) time complexity.

questions.text: A stack is implemented using an array. If the top pointer is at index 5, what is the current size of the stack?
questions.solution: If top = 5 (0-indexed), there are 6 elements at indices 0 through 5.

questions.text: Which data structure is used for implementing recursion?
questions.solution: Recursion uses the call stack (LIFO) to store function call frames and return addresses.

questions.text: Which memory has the fastest access time?
questions.solution: Cache memory is closest to the CPU and has the fastest access time (nanoseconds), followed by RAM, then SSD, then HDD.

questions.text: Which scheduling algorithm is non-preemptive?
questions.solution: First Come First Serve (FCFS) is non-preemptive - once a process gets the CPU, it runs until completion or I/O.

questions.text: The main function of an operating system is:
questions.solution: The OS manages CPU, memory, I/O devices, and provides resource allocation and protection.

questions.text: A language accepted by a Finite Automaton is called:
questions.solution: Finite automata accept exactly the class of regular languages (Type 3 in Chomsky hierarchy).

questions.text: Which of the following is NOT a valid Boolean algebra property?
questions.solution: A + A = A (idempotent law), not 0. A + A = 1 and A . A = 0.

questions.text: What does the following C expression evaluate to? (Assume i = 5) i++ + ++i
questions.solution: i++ uses current value (5) then increments to 6. ++i increments to 7 then uses 7. So 5 + 7 = 12.

questions.text: In virtual memory, which technique is used for address translation?
questions.solution: Paging maps virtual addresses to physical addresses using page tables, enabling virtual memory.

questions.text: A train 150 m long passes a pole in 15 seconds. Find the speed of the train in km/h.
questions.solution: Speed = distance/time = 150/15 = 10 m/s. In km/h: 10 x (18/5) = 36 km/h.

questions.text: Which of the following problems is undecidable?

options.label: A
options.text: Checking if a DFA accepts a given string

options.label: B
options.text: Checking if a CFL is empty

options.label: C
options.text: The Halting Problem for Turing Machines

options.label: D
options.text: Checking if an NFA accepts a given string

questions.solution: The Halting Problem is undecidable (proved by Alan Turing). All other options are decidable.

questions.text: The worst-case time complexity of quicksort is:
questions.solution: Quicksort worst-case O(n^2) when pivot is smallest/largest element (e.g., sorted array with naive pivot).

questions.text: If 5 men can build a wall in 12 days, how many days will 10 men take?
questions.solution: MD = MD -> 5x12 = 10xD -> D = 6 days.

questions.text: Find the missing number: 2, 6, 12, 20, ?
Which of the following is a linear data structure?
questions.solution: Queue is linear (elements in sequence). Tree and Graph are non-linear data structures.

questions.text: The height of a complete binary tree with n nodes is:
questions.solution: Height of a complete binary tree with n nodes is logn.

questions.text: In a min-heap, the smallest element is at:
questions.solution: Min-heap property: parent  children, so root is always the minimum element.

questions.text: Which of the following is a volatile memory?
questions.solution: RAM (Random Access Memory) is volatile - data is lost when power is turned off.

questions.text: The number of bits in a nibble is:
questions.solution: 1 nibble = 4 bits. 1 byte = 2 nibbles = 8 bits.

questions.text: Which of the following is NOT an operating system?
questions.solution: Python is a programming language, not an operating system.

questions.text: The full form of FIFO is:
questions.solution: FIFO = First In First Out - used in queue scheduling and page replacement.

questions.text: Which language is accepted by Pushdown Automata?
questions.solution: PDA accepts exactly the class of Context-Free Languages (CFL).

questions.text: If L and L are both recursively enumerable, then L is:
questions.solution: If L and its complement are both RE, then L is recursive (decidable).

questions.text: Which traversal gives sorted order in a BST?
questions.solution: Inorder traversal of BST visits nodes in ascending order (left -> root -> right).

questions.text: Find the odd one out: 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, 32
questions.solution: All others are powers of 2 (2, 2^2, 2, 2, 2). 24 is not a power of 2.

questions.text: A semaphore that is used as a binary lock is called:
questions.solution: Mutex (mutual exclusion) is a binary semaphore used for locking in concurrent programming.

questions.text: Which of the following is a universal gate?
questions.solution: NAND and NOR are universal gates - any Boolean function can be implemented using only NAND (or only NOR) gates.

questions.text: The difference between the largest 4-digit number and the smallest 3-digit number is:
If a train running at 72 km/h crosses a pole in 10 s, the length of train is:
questions.solution: Speed = 72x(5/18) = 20 m/s. Length = 20x10 = 200 m.

questions.text: Find the next term: 3, 9, 27, 81, ?
questions.solution: Geometric progression with ratio 3: 3 = 243.

questions.text: A man buys a book for 500 and sells it for 600. Profit percentage is:
Which word is opposite in meaning to "Benevolent"?
questions.solution: Benevolent = kind/generous. Opposite = malevolent (wicked/hostile).

questions.text: If 3x + 2 = 11, then x = ?
Thevenin's theorem is used to simplify:
questions.solution: Thevenin's theorem applies to linear circuits (voltage source + series resistance).

questions.text: In an RC circuit, the time constant is:
questions.solution: = RC (time for voltage to reach 63.2% of final value).

questions.text: Kirchhoff's current law is based on:
questions.solution: KCL: sum of currents entering = sum leaving (charge conservation).

questions.text: The impedance of a capacitor of capacitance C at frequency  is:
The power dissipated in a resistor R with current I is:
questions.solution: P = I^2R = V^2/R = VI.

questions.text: An ideal op-amp has infinite:
questions.solution: Ideal op-amp: infinite input impedance, zero output impedance, infinite gain.

questions.text: A diode in forward bias has:
questions.solution: Forward bias: diode conducts with low resistance (~0.7 V drop for Si).

questions.text: A transistor has three terminals: base, collector, and:
questions.solution: BJT terminals: Base, Collector, Emitter. FET: Gate, Drain, Source.

questions.text: The purpose of a heat sink in power amplifiers is to:
questions.solution: Heat sink dissipates excess heat from power transistors to prevent thermal damage.

questions.text: The gain of a non-inverting amplifier with Rf=10 k and R1=1 k is:
A Zener diode is used for:
questions.solution: Zener diode maintains constant voltage in reverse breakdown -> voltage regulator.

questions.text: Binary equivalent of decimal 15 is:
Which flip-flop has no race condition?
questions.solution: Master-slave JK flip-flop eliminates race-around condition.

questions.text: How many AND gates are needed for 8-to-1 multiplexer?
questions.solution: 8-to-1 MUX needs 8 AND gates (one per input) + 1 OR gate.

questions.text: The number of input lines for 3-to-8 decoder is:
questions.solution: 3-to-8 decoder: 3 inputs, 8 outputs.

questions.text: The output of XOR gate with inputs (1,1) is:
questions.solution: XOR: output 1 when inputs differ, 0 when same. 11 = 0.

questions.text: A counter with 4 flip-flops can count up to:
questions.solution: 4-bit counter: 2 = 16 states (0 to 15).

questions.text: The RMS value of sinusoidal voltage v = 10 sin(t) is:
The bandwidth of an ideal bandpass filter is:
questions.solution: BW = fH - fL where fH and fL are upper and lower cut-off frequencies.

questions.text: Two 10  resistors in parallel give equivalent resistance:
A 4-bit R-2R DAC uses resistors of values:
questions.solution: R-2R ladder DAC uses only R and 2R resistors for binary-weighted conversion.

questions.text: The average of first 5 prime numbers is:
Class A amplifier has conduction angle of:
questions.solution: Class A: conducts for full 360 degrees  of input cycle -> low efficiency (~25%).

questions.text: The memory size with 10 address lines and 8 data lines is:
If 15 workers can build a wall in 8 days, how many workers are needed to build same wall in 6 days?
A car travels 60 km in 1.5 hours. Its average speed is:
questions.solution: Speed = 60/1.5 = 40 km/h.

questions.text: Choose the correct spelling:
questions.solution: Correct spelling: Mischievous.

questions.text: Simplify: 25 + 5 x 2 - 10
If the radius of a circle is doubled, the area becomes:
questions.solution: A  r^2. If r -> 2r, A -> 4A.

questions.text: The ratio of 3 km to 300 m is:
The SI unit of thermal conductivity is:
questions.solution: Thermal conductivity k: W/(m.K).

questions.text: The efficiency of Carnot cycle depends on:
questions.solution: = 1 - T/T (depends only on source and sink temperatures).

questions.text: In an isothermal process, which quantity remains constant?
questions.solution: Isothermal: T = constant, PV = constant (for ideal gas).

questions.text: The unit of entropy is:
questions.solution: Entropy units: J/K (total) or kJ/kg.K (specific).

questions.text: The first law of thermodynamics is essentially:
questions.solution: U = Q - W (energy conservation for thermodynamic systems).

questions.text: Hooke's law states that stress is proportional to:
questions.solution: Within elastic limit,    (stress  strain).

questions.text: Poisson's ratio for most metals is about:
questions.solution: Poisson's ratio for metals: 0.25-0.35 (steel ~0.3). 0.5 for incompressible.

questions.text: The bending moment at a simply supported beam's center with point load P at center is:
questions.solution: Mmax = PL/4 for simply supported beam with central point load.

questions.text: The polar moment of inertia of a solid shaft of diameter D is:
questions.solution: J = piD/32 for solid shaft. (Area MOI = piD/64)

questions.text: A material that undergoes large deformation before fracture is called:
questions.solution: Ductile materials (steel, aluminum) undergo significant plastic deformation before fracture.

questions.text: Which process is used to make threads on a bolt?
questions.solution: Threading (using dies) cuts external threads on bolts and rods.

questions.text: TIG welding uses which electrode?
questions.solution: TIG (Tungsten Inert Gas) uses non-consumable tungsten electrode.

questions.text: The cutting speed in a lathe is measured in:
questions.solution: Cutting speed = piDN/1000 m/min (D in mm, N in RPM).

questions.text: Which casting process uses a wax pattern?
questions.solution: Investment (lost wax) casting: wax pattern coated with ceramic, melted out, metal poured.

questions.text: The operation of enlarging a hole is called:
questions.solution: Boring enlarges an existing hole. Reaming gives smooth finish.

questions.text: A heat engine rejects 300 J to sink while doing 200 J work. Heat supplied is:
The modulus of rigidity relates shear stress to:
questions.solution: G = / (shear stress / shear strain).

questions.text: In orthogonal cutting, the cutting edge is:
questions.solution: Orthogonal cutting: cutting edge  to cutting velocity direction.

questions.text: The COP of a refrigerator is 4. If it extracts 200 J from cold reservoir, work input is:
The simple interest on 1000 at 5% per annum for 2 years is:
A steel rod of 10 mm diameter carries 31.4 kN load. Stress is:
The material used for cutting tools is:
questions.solution: HSS retains hardness at high cutting temperatures (used for drills, end mills).

questions.text: The Otto cycle efficiency increases with:
questions.solution: = 1 - 1/r^(-1). Higher compression ratio -> higher efficiency.

questions.text: Beam deflection is maximum at:
questions.solution: Deflection depends on loading type. For UDL: max at center. For point load: at load point.
